full_judgment: 2. The opposite party No. 1 instituted Title Suit No. 144 of 1962 in the 1st court of the Munsif at Dacca for declaration of title and recovery of possession with regard to the lands detailed in schedule 'Ga.' to the plaint. The suit was decreed exparte. The defendant petitioner coming to know about the same filed an application under Order 9, Rule 13 CPC for setting aside of the exparte decree & for the rehearing of the suit. The said application was dismissed for default on 20-11-67 on the ground that the petitioner did not take any steps for service of summons which returned unserved. As against the said order the defendant-petitioner preferred an appeal. The learned Subordinate Judge dismissed the appeal on the ground that the petitioner has not been able to show any cause as to why he could not appear on the date fixed for taking steps in the suit. He also found that there was no evidence in the proceeding as the case was dismissed for want of taking any steps.
